newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish Press gets approval to sell newspaper titles.
newsitem.headline: Irish Press gets approval to sell newspaper titles.

text.p: Irish Press Publications Limited on Tuesday received shareholder approval for the sale of its newspaper titles, the Irish Press, the Sunday Press and the Evening Press.
The directors of the company are taking immediate steps to initiate the procedures necessary to achieve a sale of the titles, Irish Press Publications said in a statement.
Publication of the three papers was halted last year after Irish Press Newspapers, which published the three titles, went into liquidation.
